messages.author: 1390e3d34051af36
messages.subject: Adding new .stan model files?
parts:
Is there a way to easily add new .stan model files for newly designed tasks into the hBayesDM package, or to create new model files for use by the hBayesDM package?

Thanks so much.

Michael

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: Adding new .stan model files?
parts:
It's relatively straightforward to add new models (for us, developers), but I understand it's not that easy.. In a forthcoming manuscript with my student (Nate Haines), we plan to describe how to add new models in the appendix. Please stay tuned and thanks for your interests. If you have any models (codes) you want to be included in the hBayesDM package, please feel free to email us your codes and we can possibly add them to the package. 

Best,
Young

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: Adding new .stan model files?
parts:
Hi Matt,

Thanks for contacting us! At this point, I think it would be most ideal if you send us some required files and we will add the model to hBayesDM. 

Minimum required files include a Stan file, its example data (*.txt file), its reference, and a list of model parameters and their parameter bounds (e.g., learning rate —> between 0 and 1). 

We plan to make the package more modular to make it easier to add new models. 

Best,
Young
